name: Metaball Field Evaluation
aliases: Metaball Field Evaluation — GPU Field Generation
definition: Evaluates a dynamic scalar field composed of three moving metaballs (spheres) for density calculation at a point $(x,y,z)$.
summary: Metaball Field Evaluation is a GPU-based procedural method that generates dynamic 3D scalar density volumes for moving blobs using inverse-square falloff, distinguishing itself from static definitions and simple Gaussian blending.
